story: Sophie is in the garden. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie sees a tiny fairy sitting on a red flower. The fairy has shiny wings and a little wand. Oh no! [emotion:QT/afraid] The fairy drops the wand in the tall grass. [emotion:QT/sad] Sophie cannot reach the wand. [emotion:QT/calm] Sophie and the fairy look together. They find the wand under a big leaf. [emotion:QT/happy] The fairy picks up the wand. The fairy gives Sophie three sparkling stars. Sophie puts the stars in her pocket. [gesture:clapping] [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie is smiling and clapping her hands.
